message: Mike, I just finished a chapter in my dissertation that began with the heading, "Just Personal." I'm probably too close to it right now to say more, but there's a reason my web space is called techsophist. If students are unable to situate their thoughts in some kind of context that connects to them personally, to their lives, then there should be no surprise when the resulting texts seem vacant and interchangeable. Of course they do. No one's home.
